title: a-proof-run-by-hand-outside-cairn-test-is-refused-at-the-gate
intention: A CC tool call that runs a proof outside `cairn test` is refused at PreToolUse with the exact `cairn test` line to type instead.
why: A CC session running a proof by hand (python3 <proof>, pytest <proof>) runs it outside the tester's instance seal, against live ~/.cairn. Measured 2026-10-06: 88 of 290 proofs write live state that way (2705 paths: dated emissions, inference tickets, tester run files, appends to bus.log and last_known), and this session's own first e9a2 run leaked 6 inference tickets. The lived symptom: the operator's live logs and trouble lanes fill with fixture records nobody can tell from real ones, and one proof overwrote the live superclaude loop.pid. Parent: dda0e72b9c67.
traces_to: Law 4 (a rule that matters is enforced by physics): 'run proofs via cairn test' is a sentence in memory and the e9a2 leak shows it failing; Law 8 (a proof's green is leaned on, so its run must not damage the world it measures). Parent dda0e72b9c67.
how: New bin/cmd/proofgate, shaped like bin/cmd/deletegate: stdin JSON {tool_name, tool_input.command}; exit 2 with a stderr naming the blocked command and `bin/cairn test <proof>` when the command TEXT runs a file under a proofs/ directory by python/python3 (incl. env/timeout/strace prefixes) or runs pytest (pytest, py.test, python -m pytest) at all; exit 0 otherwise, including any `cairn test` command and reads of proof files (cat, sed, grep). Co-occurrence matching on text, as deletegate does. Registered in .claude/settings.json PreToolUse matcher Bash beside deletegate. Proof bin/proofs/test_proof_gate.py, written red.
falsifier: Done when (1) the gate refuses `python3 cairn/devices/x/proofs/test_y.py` and `cd cairn && python3 devices/x/proofs/test_y.py` with exit 2 and a stderr carrying `cairn test`; (2) it refuses `pytest cairn/tools/base/proofs/` and `python3 -m pytest -q x.py`; (3) it allows `bin/cairn test --seal cairn/devices/x/proofs/test_y.py`, `cat cairn/devices/x/proofs/test_y.py` and `python3 -c 'print(1)'`; (4) .claude/settings.json registers it under PreToolUse matcher Bash; (5) the census harness re-run as a CC Bash command is refused before any proof starts. WRONG INTENT if a legitimate CC workflow measured in the corpus needs a raw proof run that cairn test cannot serve (the census itself is run from a script file, which the text gate cannot see, and that hole is named in the gate's docstring).
watchme: none, because the gate (shaped like bin/cmd/deletegate, registered in .claude/settings.json) prints every refusal to the session it refused; its proof bin/proofs/test_proof_gate.py reds on drift via component_color
children: none, because the gate is one file plus one registration line
